name: Microsoft Project Professional 365 12 Month
description: Project Online ? This one-year subscription to Microsoft Project Professional 365 unlocks all your favorite Project Pro tools enhanced by the benefits of Office 365. Your Project Professional software is automatically kept up to date (with options for customizable policies) so you dont have to bother with incessant updates and working with outdated software. Project Professional 365 comes with all the most vital project management tools available to ensure that you keep on top of tasks, timelines and resources from one place. The latest version of Project Professional 365 comes with a slew of powerful new reporting tools, task management tools and planning tools laid out in a visually rich interface for a comfortable, productive management experience. Improve collaboration when you integrate your favorite Microsoft applications, like Skype for Business and SharePoint, to communicate in real time with team members.
